description: Command palette / Cmd+K launcher (modal dialog, combobox + listbox)

attributes.name: hotkey
attributes.description: Global keyboard shortcut that toggles the palette (fires even in text fields)

attributes.name: discover
attributes.description: Present: add commands from [data-command] / [commandfor] elements. "auto": also scan nav links and headings

structure.description: Group of commands; rendered as a role="group" named by its label
One command inside a <command-group>; its text is the label, an element with slot="icon" the icon

childAttributes.name: data-hotkey
childAttributes.description: Shortcut shown as a badge and bound page-wide while connected; fires command-palette:select without opening the palette (not in text fields)

childAttributes.name: slot
childAttributes.description: slot="icon" marks the item's icon (cloned into the option)

events.name: command-palette:select
events.description: Fired when a declared command is chosen from the list or by its data-hotkey

events.name: command-palette:close
events.description: Fired once whenever the dialog closes (close(), selection, Escape, backdrop click)

events.name: command-palette:commands-changed
events.description: Fired after the commands property rebuilds the palette

methods.name: open()
methods.description: Open the palette and focus the search input

properties.name: commands
properties.type: Array<{ value, label, hotkey?, group?, icon? }>
properties.description: Get the declared commands as data, or assign to rebuild the groups

properties.name: isOpen
properties.description: Read-only. Whether the dialog is open
